card.name: Crushing tablets or capsules
card.fires_on: The word crush or crushed in administration instructions for tablets and capsules, either allowing it or forbidding it. Also fires once on the 'ophil' part of lyophilized.

modes.label: Crush in swallowing instructions
modes.description: Crush or crushed in lists with split, chew, cut or break, or in statements that a tablet can be crushed.
modes.example: Swallow the capsules whole; do not cut, break,<< crush>> or chew the capsules.
